args.curatorialNote: Katsushika Hokusai's iconic 'The Great Wave off Kanagawa' masterfully captures the raw power of nature. Part of his 'Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji' series, this woodblock print showcases a colossal wave threatening boats, with Mount Fuji serene in the distance. Its dynamic composition and vibrant Prussian blue pigment influenced Western art, becoming a timeless symbol of Japanese artistry and the sublime force of the ocean.
